newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits steady to easier before PPI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits steady to easier before PPI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were steady to easier on Friday in dull trade with most traders sidelined before today's issue of the U.S. June producer price index (PPI), dealers said.
The producer price index for June is forecast to be unchanged from a 0.3 percent fall reported in May.

"Rates were quite steady this morning except for light activity at the short end. There was little impact from Thursday's weekly jobless claims figures and most people were sidelined," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for today's PPI figures for more clues to market direction. They are also waiting for the outcome of the (Singapore) Budget later today," he said.
In short dates, weekend eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, Monday/Tuesday was unchanged from Thursday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 and week-fixed eased 1/16 point to 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.

Among term rates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8, nine-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
